name: References
summary: Every issue, merge request and pull request in this project, from GitHub and GitLab, as one list.
guidance: Every issue, merge request and pull request the host reads for this project — GitHub and GitLab together — is listed here, and the list shows the ones the open epic names unless the header’s scope is set to something else (Everything, or the person’s own: Asked to review, Mine) — check the scope before concluding a reference does not exist. Before deciding what to work on, read the list rather than assuming the work is the one thing you were pointed at — very often a change is already open for it. Picking a row sets the canvas selection and other modules react to it, so select the reference you are working on and leave it selected while you work.
